Mia Chen: morning async — quick standup for Crestview renewal run
What I did: followed up on webhook retry logs, raised support ticket with infra, patched mapping for 204 responses
Blockers: still seeing duplicate events for new user signup (probable idempotency key missing) — can't repro in staging
Today: pushing a small patch to add idempotency header + ask eng-infra for a short-run of same config in qa

Samir Patel: looked at logs, saw 2 spikes 2026-03-16T21:03Z — forwarded trace to @Jordan Lee, possible race in worker
Recommend: add guard in handler to drop duplicates by (user_id, event_id)

Samir Patel: quick repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://webhook.crestview.com/events -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event_id":"e123","user_id":"u456"}'
```

Jordan Lee: on it, can add a DB unique constraint and idempotency check. FYI that might need migration window. timeline: PR by EOD

Anita Gomez: from CS: customer asks for ETA on fix and rollback option. They have monthly billing renewal next Tue. Suggest we offer temporary webhook filter to reduce noise.

Mia Chen: @Anita I'll send customer note with mitigation steps and ask to hold renewal if noisy? maybe offer a one-week credit

Jordan Lee: PR opened https://github.com/redwood/infer/commit/abc123 (draft). test plan included.

Samir Patel: quick code review ping @Jordan — minor nit in error handling. If you want I can pair tonight.

Jordan Lee: thanks — will address nits, request review when green. @deploy-bot please schedule canary to customer-dedicated region

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy to crestview-dedicated at 2026-03-17T15:30Z, jobs queued: 3. :robot_face:

Mia Chen: thanks team. blockers resolved? moving to monitoring. adding alert in console for duplicate webhook rate >5/min

Anita Gomez: customer update sent. They appreciated the quick response :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I'll watch logs post-deploy, will flag if anything > 2x baseline

Jordan Lee: done — PR merged, deploying now.

Mia Chen: closing check-in. If anything urgent ping #eng-oncall. /cc @Samir @Jordan @Anita
